instructions.pageDescription: Follow these 7 steps to optimize your academic planning experience
instructions.startDescription: Ready to begin? Click above to start with step 1
instructions.step1Description: Add the extension to extract your academic transcript in CSV/Excel format for study planning.
instructions.step2Description: Sign in with your MyDTU account.
instructions.step3Description: Go to Learning and choose Transcript to access your grades.
instructions.step4Description: Open the extension and select the Extractor menu to process your transcript.
instructions.step5Description: Click Extract to download your transcript as a CSV file.
instructions.step6Description: Upload the CSV file to enable grade prediction and study plan recommendations.
instructions.step7Description: Customize your settings and view an overview of your current GPA and study progress.
